workflow.title: Robust React Component Workflow
workflow.step: Keep component as React Server Component (RSC) by default. Add 'use client' only if interactivity/state is required (FE-ARCH-001).
Model internal/external states with Discriminated Unions to make invalid states unrepresentable (FE-TS-002).
Implement explicit views for: Initial/Empty, Loading, Error, Partial/Data, and Success (UI-STA-001).
Ensure full ARIA compliance, focus trap for modals, and minimum 48px touch targets (UI-A11Y-001, UI-LAW-002).
